title: Waveform Highway
signatureMechanic: rhythmic equalizer-bar slalom walls (every 8 rows) with guardrails that follow the sweep, building to one big void jump as the drop
intent: The track should feel like it is dancing to a beat: a sweeping S-curve slalom locked to the 8-row rhythm builds tension, eases for one breath, then commits to a single telegraphed void jump that is the unmistakable drop.

beats.label: Sound Check
beats.telegraph: open flat runway; nothing to dodge — establish baseline speed
beats.notes: safe accel runway; player reads the violet road and pink borders before anything happens

beats.label: First Bars
beats.telegraph: guardrails lead the sweep; walls snap to the 8-row phrase so the cadence is learnable
beats.notes: rhythm 8: introduce the equalizer-bar slalom uncombined and at moderate amplitude (A5 safe-intro)

beats.label: Build
beats.telegraph: tighter slalom amplitude; rails stay but obstacles appear between bars
beats.notes: escalate the same rhythm; combine slalom with light obstacles — no new lethal mechanic

beats.label: The Pause
beats.telegraph: walls fall away, road widens — visible calm before the drop
beats.notes: A4 sawtooth trough: a real sub-threshold breather so the climax lands

beats.label: The Drop
beats.telegraph: boost runway + ramp marker a full phrase (8 rows) before the gap; the void gap is visually unmistakable
beats.notes: single dominant late peak (A6): boost runway -> ramp -> void gap -> refill safeLanding island. riskReward boost on the line, >=3 flat clean landing rows after

beats.label: Fade Out
beats.notes: safe outro; let the player exhale after the drop

successCriteria.climax: the void jump must be the single hardest and most-telegraphed moment; it must be player-caused (commit the boost) not just a dense cluster
successCriteria.fairness: every slalom wall must read one phrase (8 rows) ahead at maxSpeedNormal; the void gap must not be hidden behind a crest
successCriteria.arc: intensity must visibly dip in the breather (~0.56-0.66) before climbing to the climax; the rhythm should read as deliberate, not random walls
